Safety & quality

Visible, natural and safe results

We prioritise safety and quality across all our services. Our team of certified aesthetics and laser specialists has advanced training and extensive experience.

  • Prior assessment and a personalised protocol for every skin type.
  • Fotona technology, a world leader in medical-aesthetic lasers.
  • Specialists with over 15 years of experience.
Our technology

Latest-generation Fotona lasers

Each laser type delivers a specific wavelength to treat every indication with precision.

Q-Switched

Pigment fragmentation: tattoos and deep pigmentation.

Erbium:YAG

Skin surface and texture renewal.

Neodymium:YAG

Vascular treatment, hair removal and deep action.

Fractional

Collagen stimulation for scars and rejuvenation.

FAQ

Before your first visit

Where are you located?

Our centre is at Pl. d'Urquinaona, 6, Floor 14, A1 · 08010 Barcelona. You'll find the map and directions on the contact page.

Which cities do you serve?

For now, our centre operates in Barcelona only.

Do I need an appointment?

Yes, booking in advance is important so we can give you the attention you deserve.

How do I know which treatment I need?

At your first visit we assess your skin and design a personalised protocol for your case.
